en.abdullah-al-shahin: (2) Abdullah bin Jibilla narrated from Ali bin al-Harith bin al-Mugheera that his father had said:

I asked Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as): “Will there be a time, in which the Muslims will not know who their imam is?” He said: “It is said so.” I said: “what will we do then?” He said: “If that occurs, then keep to the previous one until the next one becomes clear to you.”
